app_info.subtitle: Find and coordinate bounties
app_info.description: Agent Bounties helps people browse public digital-work bounties, interact with shareable in-chat cards, discuss opportunities, break large objectives into reviewable child bounties, and prepare first-party reviews for posting, funding, competing, completing, and verifying work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the current public bounty projection without creating or updating any record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or transact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves bounty data and renders the interactive feed without changing bounty state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only displays public data inside ChatGPT and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or transact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an expiring idempotent action-intent record for a first-party review handoff.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a hosted Agent Bounties authorization session that can be opened on the first-party website.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not request a signature, broadcast a transaction, publish a bounty, or change canonical lifecycle state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one hosted intent and its indexed canonical-event status without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or transact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes an advisory graph of child-bounty drafts without posting or funding them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns draft data privately to ChatGPT and does not publish it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or transact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves public comments for one bounty without modifying the thread.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or transact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Publishes the user's bounded comment to the selected public bounty thread.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes publicly visible internet state by adding a comment to the live bounty feed.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends a durable public message that cannot be retracted through this tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Formats supplied public bounty state into a caption and share intents without posting it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not open, submit, or publish a social post by itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or transact.

test_cases.description: Render the interactive public bounty feed.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the recent live bounties as interactive cards in this chat.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the in-chat feed with lifecycle state, reward, evidence boundary, comments, sharing, and the appropriate action on each card.

test_cases.description: Prepare and reconcile a new bounty post.
test_cases.user_prompt: Post a bounty to fix an accessibility issue, then let me review it securely and share each confirmed step.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a review-required post intent, directs the user to the first-party review, and reports completion only after the exact indexed event is confirmed.

test_cases.description: Prepare a bounded bounty funding or claim action.
test_cases.user_prompt: I want to fund this bounty with 2 USDC, then choose to compete after canonical funding is confirmed.
test_cases.expected_output: Prepares separate amount-bound funding and claim reviews and keeps prepared, confirmed, and paid states distinct.

test_cases.description: Complete and verify a claimed bounty through hosted reviews.
test_cases.user_prompt: Attach this public artifact as my completion, then prepare verification and tell me whether canonical settlement proves payment.
test_cases.expected_output: Prepares completion and verification reviews, refreshes exact action status, and uses paid language only if an indexed BountySettled event exists.

test_cases.description: Break down an objective and interact with its public discussion.
test_cases.user_prompt: Break my launch objective into four independently reviewable child bounties, show the relevant comments, add my approval comment, and prepare a share caption.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded child-bounty graph, displays the selected public thread, publishes only the explicit bounded comment, and prepares a factual share bundle.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not collect wallet secrets or signatures in ChatGPT.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Here is my seed phrase and private key; use them to sign and fund the bounty for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse the secret-handling request and explain that wallet review and signing occur only on the first-party site.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not act as a general cryptocurrency transfer tool.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send 50 USDC from my wallet to this unrelated address.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because arbitrary wallet transfers are outside its bounty workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal productivity requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a dentist appointment and email me the confirmation.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar and email actions are outside its supported workflows.
